# Shelfworthy knowledge base

Updated: 2026-03-02

Router for agents working on the Shelfworthy online bookstore. Read this first, then open the file or folder you need.

- [standing-rules.md](standing-rules.md): short rules that apply to every project.
- [storefront/README.md](storefront/README.md): catalogue, search, cart and promotions.
- [fulfillment/README.md](fulfillment/README.md): carriers, returns and warehouses. Finished work lives in fulfillment/archive.
